title: Self-Pay Terms: Unpaid Balance and the Deposit on a Moved In-Person Appointments Visit
content:
**Term.** The deposit a moved In-Person Appointments visit requires takes an addition according to the unpaid balance counted for it, which is drawn from the unpaid balance on the patient's Patient Financial Account:

| Unpaid balance counted | Added to the deposit the moved visit requires |
|---|---|
| above 100.00 dollars | 50.00 dollars |
| above zero and up to 100.00 dollars | 25.00 dollars |
| zero or less | nothing |

**Around each line (hypothetical balances).** $100.50 counted: 50.00 dollars added. $100.00 counted: 25.00 dollars. $0.40 counted: 25.00 dollars. $0.00 counted: nothing. A counted balance below zero: nothing.
